annotations.title: Fence and gate post spacing, post count and gate weight

description: Post count and spacing for a chain link or ornamental steel fence run, chain link footing depth and gate post size, and the weight and hinge loads of an ornamental steel gate leaf.

gap_in.description: Ornamental gate: largest gap between pickets in inches (4 in is the most the maker chart allows).

gate_ft.description: Gate opening in feet, 0 for no gate (0 to 24). The gate sits at the end of the run.

height_ft.description: Fence and gate height in feet (3 to 12).

hinge_spacing_in.description: Distance between the two hinges in inches. Default: gate height less 24 in.

mid_rails.description: Ornamental gate: rails between the top and bottom rail.

panel.description: chain-link (line posts 10 ft apart at most) or ornamental steel tubular pickets (8 ft, 96 in on center).

picket_in.description: Ornamental gate: square picket size in inches.

post_od_in.description: Chain link line post outside diameter in inches, to get the footing diameter.

run_ft.description: Length of the fence run in feet, not counting the gate (3 to 2,000).

tube_in.description: Ornamental gate frame: square tube outside size in inches.

wall_in.description: Ornamental gate frame: tube wall in inches (0.12 is about 11 gauge).

name: fence_and_gate_post_spacing_and_weight
